scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build --workspace functions
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-funka --only auth,firestore,functions 'vitest run tests/security.test.ts tests/backend.test.ts tests/admin.test.ts'
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-funka --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-funka --only auth,firestore,functions 'playwright test --config playwright.emulators.config.ts'
scripts.test:spark: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.spark.json --project demo-funka --only auth,firestore "vitest run tests/spark-security.test.ts"
scripts.test:spark:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.spark.json --project demo-funka --only auth,firestore "playwright test --config playwright.spark.config.ts"
